## Change

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue when relevant.

## Validation

List the relevant commands or CI results, and any remaining limitations.

- [ ] Meaningful behavior regression added when needed; existing checks preserved.
- [ ] Documentation and generated code reference updated where responsibilities changed.
- [ ] No patient data, private exports, workstation paths, keys or databases included.
- [ ] Dependency changes include regenerated runtime/dev locks, `pip check` and audits.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the exact quality commands.
